validatorSnapshot.notes: Initial Interchain validators are manually selected in genesisValidatorManifest. CLI destination proofs are verified automatically; no origin snapshot required

reserve.notes: Approved Base initial Registry V3 economics (2026-10-14): 0.00005 ETH minimum, 0.00003 ETH max executor reimbursement, 0.0001 ETH initial reserve per validator (0.0003 ETH for 3), excluding deployment gas. Wallet sender must confirm exact signed value.

sourceFee.notes: Approved Base initial source-native validator fee: 0.0000001 ETH (100000000000 wei) per Base-originating transfer, additional to chain gas. Fixed at Factory constructor and set in the source Registry with nonce 0; only subsequent fee changes need validator BLS quorum.

notes: EIP-2537 runtime verifier requires proven precompile support and negative/positive BLS vectors before deployment.
